title: Make the Bishop Come Home
setup: Black's bishop on a4 is far from its king and both its rooks have gone hunting on the b- and h-files.
hint: One black piece is a long way from the eighth rank. Give it a reason to have to be there.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qc8+}} forces {{Be8}}, hauling the bishop all the way back to block, and {{Qxe8#}} takes it on arrival. A piece that can reach a square in one move is not the same as a piece defending it.
